implementation.core: Extended the existing FoundationControlService executor, existing outbox dispatcher and FlowRuntimeService. No replacement engine, Base edits, schema/table changes or per-module CRUD code.
implementation.after_execution: CRUD commits with the pinned binding and outbox. Flow start and delivery acknowledgement share the locked delivery transaction. Failure rolls back only delivery; retry uses the original published version.
implementation.flow_only: Validate configured fields, ownership and record version, then start the pinned Flow in the action transaction. No physical CRUD supplier runs. The response has FLOW_STARTED, flowInstanceId and a null record value.
implementation.receipts: Opt-in Prefer: return=action preserves legacy record responses. Authenticated action-result lookup reports STARTED/PENDING/RETRYING without exposing payloads or raw internal errors.
implementation.frontend: The shared runtime action caller is used by create/update/delete for all configured modules, preserves a request key across a lost response in the open form, and distinguishes record results from Flow-only results. Readback failures do not masquerade as failed writes.
implementation.legacy_callers: Legacy service methods which promise a record reject a record-less result inside their transaction. Import/AI/application Flow-only result adaptation is still required in their assigned packets.
implementation.scope_extension_reason: FlowRuntimeService and its delivery adapter are direct dependencies of B01.3. The shared frontend caller and three write handlers must consume record-less Flow receipts safely; layout replacement was not included.

limitations: This verifies B01.3's runtime integration, not completion of all Flow requirements or the system.
AFTER_APPROVAL pending intent and once-only resume remain B01.4; advanced approvals and the real approval journey remain B08-B10.

Import, AI and application callers still need receipt adaptation (B13/B17/B11). FLOW_ONLY currently fails explicitly and transactionally there instead of creating a Flow followed by a null-record error.
A bound Flow requires an active initiator membership in the data tenant. A shared-data actor without one has an explicit start failure; complete cross-tenant delegation semantics remain B03/B11.
Existing Flow writeback/status paths and durable causation propagation must join the common action contract in B08-B10.
Page response handling was built and unit-tested, not browser visually accepted. Shared shells/layouts remain B02, field runtime B05, complete shared forms B06.
UI request identity survives retries in the current open form; restoration of pending submissions across reloads remains for B06.
